2: A Psalm. A song for the Sabbath day. It is good to praise the LORD, and to sing praises to Your name, O Most High,
3: to proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning and Your faithfulness at night
4: with the ten-stringed harp and the melody of the lyre.
5: For You, O LORD, have made me glad by Your deeds; I sing for joy at the works of Your hands.
6: How great are Your works, O LORD, how deep are Your thoughts!
7: A senseless man does not know, and a fool does not understand,
8: that though the wicked sprout like grass, and all evildoers flourish, they will be forever destroyed.
9: But You, O LORD, are exalted forever!
10: For surely Your enemies, O LORD, surely Your enemies will perish; all evildoers will be scattered.
11: But You have exalted my horn like that of a wild ox; with fine oil I have been anointed.
12: My eyes see the downfall of my enemies; my ears hear the wailing of my wicked foes.
13: The righteous will flourish like a palm tree, and grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
14: Planted in the house of the LORD, they will flourish in the courts of our God.
15: In old age they will still bear fruit; healthy and green they will remain,
16: to proclaim, “The LORD is upright; He is my Rock, and in Him there is no unrighteousness.”
